verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference platform, but every piece of evidence describes a Fireworks-managed service. Clients point at api.fireworks.ai, and Fireworks runs the GPUs and its own global fleet. Keeping fine-tuned weights and an open-source benchmarking tool are adjacent features, not a self-hostable version of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
